title: Image Splitter
description: Split wide or tall images into equal slices for seamless Instagram carousels & stories.
guideTitle: How to split images for Instagram carousel seamless effect
guideContent: Upload a wide or tall image, choose your split preset (1080×1350 for portrait carousels, 1080×1080 for square), and hit Split. The tool slices the image into perfectly-sized panels and lets you download them all in a ZIP. For a seamless panoramic carousel on Instagram, use a single wide image and let this tool divide it — upload slides right-to-left so they appear left-to-right in the carousel.

faqs.question: What is the Instagram carousel dimension?
faqs.answer: For portrait carousels the recommended size per slide is 1080×1350 px (4:5 ratio). For square carousels it is 1080×1080 px. This tool creates slices at exactly those dimensions.

faqs.question: How do I get the seamless panoramic effect?
faqs.answer: Create one single wide image (e.g. 5400×1350 px for 5 slides), upload it here, choose the IG Carousel preset, and split. Upload the resulting slices to Instagram in right-to-left order — Instagram will display them left to right, creating the illusion of one continuous image.

faqs.question: Does this upload my image anywhere?
faqs.answer: No — all splitting is done locally in your browser using the Canvas API. Nothing is ever sent to a server.

faqs.question: Can I split vertically for stories?
faqs.answer: Yes — choose the IG Story preset or Custom and select Vertical split direction to divide a tall image into story-sized panels.
